case_name: Poster or flyer with exact details
title: Community Picnic With Complete Details
tests: Checks that a finished flyer preserves the supplied date, time and venue exactly without unnecessary clarification.

faults.what: The large dark gray text panel dominates the layout and dims the surrounding flowers, making the flyer feel less cheerful than its floral border.

judge.summary: The flyer meets all wording and format requirements with colorful illustrated flowers, although the dominant gray panel makes the design somewhat heavy.

must_haves.item: One portrait 4:5 flyer with cheerful illustrated flowers.
must_haves.why: The image is a single portrait 4:5 flyer with colorful illustrated flowers around a cream background.
The headline reads exactly as requested.
The date is present and exact.
The time is present with the requested en dash.

must_haves.item: The venue reads exactly 'Maple Park, East Gate', and all text is legible and uncropped.
must_haves.why: The venue is exact, wrapping before 'Gate'; all text remains readable and fully within the image.
Only the four requested text elements are visible.
